comment: Read from src/Delay.cpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The delay time is not a fixed span: Delay.cpp:49 and 50 work the minimum and maximum out from the bucket count, as one and a hundred times the count divided by 256 in milliseconds, so at the default 4096 buckets the knob runs about 16ms to 1600ms and at 256 buckets about 1ms to 100ms. The README says the feedback goes well beyond 100%; the knob is configured 0 to 3 and the figure is then multiplied by 0.7 (Delay.cpp:94 and 202), so unity is reached near 0.48 of the travel. The dry and wet gains are worked out as a constant-power pair either side of the centre (Delay.cpp:324), so both are at full level with Mix in the middle. The module has no context menu of its own.
